news.headline: Novo Nordisk's ZEUS Trial Reaches Completion
news.summary: The Phase 3 ZEUS cardiovascular outcomes trial testing ziltivekimab (an IL-6 inhibitor) in patients with atherosclerotic disease, chronic kidney disease and systemic inflammation reached completion/data lock on July 27, 2026. Full results are pending analysis and disclosure, positioning ziltivekimab as a potential growth pillar beyond the GLP-1 franchise.

news.headline: Novo Nordisk seeks preliminary injunction to block Eli Lilly's GLP-1 ad campaign
news.summary: Escalating its July 21 lawsuit, Novo Nordisk asked a New Jersey federal court on July 24, 2026 for a preliminary injunction to immediately halt Eli Lilly's nationwide Zepbound/Mounjaro ad campaign, which Novo says misleadingly compares Lilly's drugs to an outdated, lower-dose version of Wegovy. Eli Lilly has denied wrongdoing and says it will vigorously defend advertising it calls truthful and backed by head-to-head clinical trial data.

news.headline: Novo Nordisk's CagriSema head-to-head trial vs. Lilly's tirzepatide wraps up
news.summary: The Phase 3 study directly pitting CagriSema 2.4mg against Eli Lilly's tirzepatide 15mg in type 2 diabetes patients (NCT06221969) had its status updated to completed, with core data now locked ahead of an expected readout later in 2026. This follows CagriSema's earlier REDEFINE-4 miss on weight-loss non-inferiority versus tirzepatide in February 2026.

news.headline: Novo Nordisk receives European Commission approval of Wegovy pill as first oral GLP-1 for weight management in the EU
news.summary: The European Commission approved oral semaglutide 25 mg (Wegovy pill) for adults with obesity or overweight with a weight-related comorbidity across all 27 EU member states plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein, following the CHMP's May 2026 positive opinion; a single ready-to-use pen for the higher 7.2 mg injectable dose was also cleared. Eli Lilly still has no approved oral GLP-1 rival in Europe, giving Novo a first-mover window in the region.

news.headline: Novo Nordisk's denecimig (Mim8) shows positive long-term safety and efficacy in phase 3 hemophilia A extension study
news.summary: At the ISTH Congress in Paris, Novo Nordisk presented interim FRONTIER4 extension-study data on 426 hemophilia A patients showing low annualized bleeding rates of 0.75 in adults/adolescents and 0.37 in children with a clean safety profile across weekly, biweekly and monthly dosing. The data support the BLA already filed with the FDA in September 2025 and reinforce Novo's pipeline diversification beyond GLP-1 obesity/diabetes drugs.

news.headline: Medicare GLP-1 Bridge cuts Wegovy cost to $50/month copay for eligible beneficiaries
news.summary: Starting July 1, 2026, the CMS-run Medicare GLP-1 Bridge demonstration gives eligible Medicare Part D beneficiaries with obesity access to Wegovy injection and tablets (alongside Eli Lilly's Zepbound and Foundayo) for a flat $50 monthly copay, running through the end of 2027. The program removes a major reimbursement barrier that had largely limited obesity-drug uptake to commercially insured and cash-pay patients.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Novo Nordisk is scheduled to report second-quarter and first-half 2026 financial results before market open on August 5, 2026 (07:30 CEST), with investors watching updated full-year guidance (already pointing to a low-single-digit sales decline for 2026), US Wegovy/Ozempic volume and share trends including early Medicare GLP-1 Bridge uptake, and commentary on competitive pressure from Eli Lilly plus the advertising lawsuit/injunction fight.

catalysts.label: CagriSema vs. tirzepatide head-to-head readout
catalysts.detail: Full data from the completed Phase 3 trial pitting CagriSema 2.4mg directly against Eli Lilly's tirzepatide 15mg in type 2 diabetes is expected, seen as a key catalyst to restore confidence after February's REDEFINE-4 miss.

catalysts.label: ZEUS (ziltivekimab) cardiovascular outcomes data disclosure
catalysts.detail: Following the trial's July 27 completion, full results on whether IL-6 inhibition with ziltivekimab reduces cardiovascular events in atherosclerotic/CKD patients are due to be analyzed and disclosed, potentially opening a new pipeline pillar beyond GLP-1s.

catalysts.when: Q4 2026 (exact PDUFA date not yet public)
catalysts.label: FDA decision on CagriSema for chronic weight management
catalysts.detail: CagriSema's NDA was submitted in December 2025 under standard (non-priority) review, implying a decision around late 2026; approval would give Novo a next-generation obesity drug to compete with Lilly's Zepbound/orforglipron franchise.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on denecimig (Mim8) for hemophilia A
catalysts.detail: Denecimig's BLA was submitted to the FDA in September 2025, supported by fresh FRONTIER4 long-term extension data presented at ISTH on July 11, 2026; approval would give Novo a new FVIIIa-mimetic prophylaxis option, diversifying revenue beyond GLP-1s.

catalysts.label: Novo Nordisk v. Eli Lilly advertising lawsuit
catalysts.detail: Court proceedings on Novo's suit seeking to block Lilly's Zepbound/Mounjaro comparative ads and force corrective advertising, including a preliminary-injunction motion filed July 24, could affect competitive messaging and market-share dynamics in the US GLP-1 market.

pulse: Novo Nordisk enters August 2026 with two pivotal Phase 3 trials freshly completed and locked -- the CagriSema vs. tirzepatide head-to-head and the ziltivekimab ZEUS cardiovascular outcomes study -- setting up binary data catalysts later this year, while the company has escalated its rivalry with Eli Lilly by seeking a preliminary injunction against Lilly's GLP-1 advertising. Regulatory and access momentum remains a bright spot -- EU approval of the oral Wegovy pill (July 15), positive long-term hemophilia A data for denecimig at ISTH (July 11), and the July 1 Medicare GLP-1 Bridge cutting US patient costs to $50/month -- but shares remain well off their 2025 highs following February's CagriSema disappointment and slowing US growth. The August 5 H1 earnings release is the next major test of trajectory amid intensifying Lilly competition.
